normalization: Talents 1.5 × global modifier 1.25 × each hero's Ascension 1.5 = 2.8125. Screenshots were taken with no heroes deployed, so Grand Master and placement effects are absent. Each base is inferred as the unique whole-number magnitude that reproduces the screenshot under this scale and nearest-integer display rounding; cooldown signs are restored afterward.
normalizationNotes: Base values are inferred from rounded displays, not read as unrounded game values. The original ingestion screenshots had zero deployed heroes and retain account scale 2.8125. A separate nine-Grand-Master Militia capture supports compounded milestone strength: 2.8125 * 1.1^9 reproduces all 17 displays; the prior additive Grand Master interpretation reproduces none. Tile state and its interaction are unverified in that capture. The three synergy-only +5% bonuses do not apply to milestones. Effective bonuses retain fractions. Captain's Power Mage Energy base of 10 is conditional on the same scaling rule and remains flagged; Power Mage Energy contributes to the user-defined Energy + Power Mages objective; other named skill effects are visible but unscored.
grandMasterMilestoneStackingEvidence: Inferred from the separate nine-Grand-Master Militia screenshot and confirmed component values; supersedes the earlier additive interpretation without changing zero-deployment base normalization.
calculationStatus: Screenshot-derived milestones for the 42-hero spreadsheet roster are active through level 10000. Synergies remain from the original spreadsheet. The other 18 heroes await data.

scaleAnalysis.assumption: Same original percentage values, common multiplier, nearest-integer display rounding
scaleAnalysis.note: Compatibility does not prove unchanged base values or identify the bonus sources. Discrepancies may be balance changes or other account effects. The interval over all comparable rows is null when no common scale fits; matching rows and exceptions are reported separately.
